Attached: 1 image

Technical one for the sales-ops builders: qualify inbound callers while they're still on the phone.
1. call.answered fires a webhook the second they pick up2. Your agent asks the three questions your sales team always asks — budget, timeline, fit3. A scoring function tags the lead hot / warm / cold in real time4. Hot lead? The agent books the demo directly, or bridges a human in mid-call
No form fills. No "we'll call you back." The qualification IS the call.
#VoiceAI #AIAgents
